newsitem.title: USA: Dell prices new notebook PCs at $2,700.
newsitem.headline: Dell prices new notebook PCs at $2,700.

text.p: Dell Computer Co said Tuesday it would sell its two new notebook personal computers at prices starting at $2,700.

The computer company said it would sell its new Latitude LM computer with a 133MHz processor, 16 mega-bytes of memory, a 1.6 giga-byte hard drive and 12X CD-ROM drive for $2,699. It added it priced its new Latitude XPi CD at $3,199.

Dell said users of its Latitude LM computers can increase the hard-drive's capacity to 4.0 giga-bytes, while XPi computer users can increase capacity to 5.0 giga-bytes. The company said it expected to ship models with increased capacity later this month.
The computer maker also said it is cutting prices of its Latitude Xpi CD notebook PCs with 166MHz processors by $200 to $3,399.
